message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day battles of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑Belgian, Prussian)** | ~23 000 |
| **French** | ~25 000 |
| **Total** | ~48 000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical research; exact numbers vary slightly among sources.
